verdict.rationale: An auth service could plausibly offer in-product AI insights, such as anomaly or sign-in pattern suggestions, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents only authentication features (OAuth, MFA, SSO, JWTs, hooks, sessions). The llms.txt and markdown docs probes make documentation readable by AI tools, which is not AI-generated insight from user data inside the product, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
